announcements.title: Codex Accounts Manager 0.1.21-l5 — Credential renewal sync
announcements.summary: Keep shared account credentials current across a primary device and its followers.
announcements.content:
This stable local build adds primary-led credential renewal sync for shared accounts.
1. The primary device remains active and visible while it renews and publishes the latest credentials.
2. Follower devices use the shared account and accept credential updates without initiating renewal.
3. The Relay stores only the latest end-to-end encrypted snapshot; retries, version checks, and acknowledgments handle transient delivery failures.

zh.title: Codex Accounts Manager 0.1.21-l5 — 账号续期同步
zh.summary: 在主设备和从设备之间保持共享账号凭据最新。
zh.content:
本稳定本地版本为共享账号增加由主设备负责的凭据续期同步。
1. 主设备会继续保持活动和可见，并负责续期和发布最新凭据。
2. 从设备可以使用共享账号并接收凭据更新，不主动发起续期。
3. Relay 只保存端到端加密的最新快照，并通过重试、版本检查和确认应对临时传输失败。
